pages.speaker: npc
lines: I'm Brock! I'm Pewter's Gym Leader! I believe in rock hard defense and determination!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: That's why my Pokémon are all the rock-type!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Do you still want to challenge me? Fine then! Show me your best!
input: !q.is_blank(v.advancement) ? q.run_command('/execute at @e[type=marker,tag=' + v.advancement + '_pos,limit=1,sort=nearest] run tp ' + q.player.username() + ' ~ ~ ~ facing entity ' + q.npc.uuid() );
q.run_command('tbcs battle GEN_9_SINGLES ' + q.player.username() + ' vs ' + q.npc.uuid() + ' as rctmod:leader_brock_019e')

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I took you for granted. As proof of your victory, here's the Boulder Badge! That's an official Pokémon League Badge!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: A TM, Technical Machine, contains a technique for Pokémon. Using a TM teaches the move it contains to a Pokémon. Anyways TM39 contains Rock Tomb. It hurls boulders at the foe and lowers its Speed.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: There are all kinds of trainers in the world! You appear to be very gifted as a Pokémon trainer! Go to the Gym in Cerulean and test your abilities!
